text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired cabinet meeting which took several measures including need to sign accords with foreign countries over social security situation of emigrated workers.
- President Ben Ali discusses with Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi food supplies for the next Ramadan month which starts by January.
- Tunis Trade Fair to start on October 18, with the participation of 40 countries and 800 firms, half of which are foreigners.
